nodes.name: Every 6h
nodes.notes: ADR-055 Block 5.3: health dead-man's-switch for the self-hosted image MCP server (Haxe Image MCP (v1), https://agents.haxe.ai/mcp/haxe-image-gen). Probes the endpoint every 6h with the bearer so a down/misauthed endpoint — which would make EVERY image-via-MCP call fail once the managed lane is live — is caught within ~6h, not silently at the next real image task. Mirrors Managed Agents Auth Monitor (v1).

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test entry for Definition-of-Done verification via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs (a Schedule Trigger cannot be fired over the n8n API). No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Get Image MCP Bearer
nodes.notes: Reads the image_mcp_bearer_token Vault secret via SECURITY DEFINER getter public.get_image_mcp_bearer() (migration 036). Same value the n8n credential 'Image MCP bearer (ADR-055)' validates on the trigger and that is mirrored into the Anthropic Vault (config.image_mcp_vault_id). Returns {bearer} (null until seeded).

nodes.name: Bearer Present?
nodes.notes: Distinguishes a config gap (Vault secret unseeded) from an endpoint failure. Empty bearer -> CRITICAL 'seed the secret'. Non-empty -> probe the live MCP endpoint. (main[1] is the IF false branch.)

nodes.name: Probe Image MCP
nodes.notes: POST an MCP 'initialize' (JSON-RPC) to the image MCP endpoint with the bearer. Verified (Block 5.3): authed initialize -> 200 text/event-stream, closes in ~18ms; bad/missing bearer -> 403; inactive/wrong path -> 404. So 2xx = healthy (endpoint up AND bearer accepted); any non-2xx/network error routes to the error output (onError) -> CRITICAL.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'initialize', params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'haxe-image-mcp-health', version: '1' } } }) }}

nodes.name: Healthy
nodes.notes: Terminal for the healthy path. Silent on purpose — a healthy probe must NOT post to the Alerts task every 6h.

nodes.name: Alert Bearer Missing
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025) when the Vault secret is unseeded.

value.message: Sekret Vault 'image_mcp_bearer_token' nie istnieje — health-check Image MCP nie moze sie uwierzytelnic.
value.details: Zasiej sekret w Vault i odswiez poswiadczenie n8n 'Image MCP bearer (ADR-055)' oraz poswiadczenie w Anthropic Vault (config.image_mcp_vault_id). Getter: public.get_image_mcp_bearer() (migracja 036).

nodes.name: Alert MCP Down
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) when the probe returns non-2xx or the endpoint is unreachable. 403 = bearer rejected (rotate/mismatch between Vault, n8n cred and Anthropic Vault); 404 = workflow inactive/wrong path; 5xx/timeout = endpoint down. Once the managed lane is live, every image-via-MCP call would fail until fixed.
